media_assets_bytes_present.name: media_assets_bytes_present
media_assets_bytes_present.value: "media_assets"."data" is not null or ("media_assets"."storage_key" is not null and "media_assets"."key_version" is not null)

push_subscriptions_owner_ck.name: push_subscriptions_owner_ck
push_subscriptions_owner_ck.value:
("push_subscriptions"."owner_type" = 'staff' and "push_subscriptions"."membership_id" is not null and "push_subscriptions"."patient_id" is null)
      or ("push_subscriptions"."owner_type" = 'customer' and "push_subscriptions"."patient_id" is not null and "push_subscriptions"."membership_id" is null)

services_window_dates_ordered.name: services_window_dates_ordered
services_window_dates_ordered.value: "services"."booking_window_kind" <> 'date_range' or ("services"."booking_window_from" is not null and "services"."booking_window_through" is not null and "services"."booking_window_through" >= "services"."booking_window_from")

tenant_data_keys_shape_valid.name: tenant_data_keys_shape_valid
tenant_data_keys_shape_valid.value:
("tenant_data_keys"."provider" = 'legacy' and "tenant_data_keys"."version" = 0 and "tenant_data_keys"."wrapped_key" is null)
      or ("tenant_data_keys"."provider" <> 'legacy' and "tenant_data_keys"."version" > 0 and "tenant_data_keys"."wrapped_key" is not null and "tenant_data_keys"."master_key_id" is not null)

workflow_steps_body_length.name: workflow_steps_body_length
workflow_steps_body_length.value: char_length("workflow_steps"."body") <= 2000 and (char_length("workflow_steps"."body") >= 1 or "workflow_steps"."template_key" is not null)
